title: 阿波罗面临赎回压力激增
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now is Bloomberg senior reporter Silas Brown. Silas, is that all this is?
segments.zh: 欢迎彭博高级记者 Silas Brown。Silas，这就是全部吗？

segments.en: People trying to gain the system and time there with draws to jump to the front of the queue and ask for more money out?
segments.zh: 人们试图钻空子，提前取款，插队并要求更多资金？

segments.en: Well, I think the most notable thing in the second quarter is we're starting to see what's really going on here, which is that the leading private credit players,
segments.zh: 第二季度最值得注意的是，我们开始看清真相：领先的私人信贷参与者，

segments.en: the ones that have benefited most from the rise of interest in retail customers are the ones that are most vulnerable
segments.zh: 那些从零售客户兴趣增长中受益最多的，现在也是最脆弱的。

segments.en: in this moment of acts. And so you see Apollo, the likes of Apollo, Blackstone, Cliffwater, the ones that have really kind of generated the most amount of interest among retail.
segments.zh: 比如 Apollo、Blackstone、Cliffwater，这些在零售领域引起最大兴趣的公司。

segments.en: They're the ones that have attracted the hot money. And actually the smaller BDCs have had much more limited, much more limited redemption or like much more limited outflows
segments.zh: 它们吸引了热钱。而较小的 BDC 则面临更有限的赎回或资金流出。

segments.en: from that segment. And I think that kind of dynamic is playing out quite neatly in the second quarter so far.
segments.zh: 我认为这种动态在第二季度至今表现得相当明显。

segments.en: This is, yeah, a story by Laura Benitez and Olivia Fishlow and it's well done.
segments.zh: 这是 Laura Benitez 和 Olivia Fishlow 的报道，写得很好。

segments.en: But I wonder at some point, do we just flash a headline and put out a BFW when redemptions are higher than the 5% where they're gated?
segments.zh: 但我想知道，当赎回超过5%的门槛时，我们是否直接发头条和 BFW？

segments.en: Because this is just going to keep happening, right?
segments.zh: 因为这种情况会持续发生，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, I think I speak on behalf of many of the print journalists.
segments.zh: 我代表许多纸媒记者说句话。

segments.en: I think maybe we would be spending our time best spent elsewhere if we did that.
segments.zh: 如果那样做，我们可能是在浪费时间。
